column3: NKJV has “scourge Him, and spit on Him,” the order of the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “spit on Him and scourge Him.” “After three days” (critical text) appears as “the third day,” following the Textus Receptus.
NKJV has “it shall not be so,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has the present “it is not so.”
NKJV has “commanded him to be called,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “said, ‘Call him.’”
NKJV has “he rose,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “he jumped up.”
